firstPlayerRule: Nobody goes first: both players turn up a card at the same time. Anyone may deal.
clarifications: If the turned-up cards match in rank, it is War: each player adds one card face down and one face up.

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards War page in a browser. "Anyone may deal first." "Each player turns up a card at the same time and the player with the higher card takes both cards". Codex rechecked the complete official HTML rules on 2026-10-20 under the owner's indexing-recovery authorization. The Deal still allows anyone to deal, and The Play still has both players reveal simultaneously. A first-player tie or random starter is therefore inapplicable; explicit presentation flags remove those generic suggestions. The existing clarification about equal-rank cards remains intact: each player adds one face-down and one face-up card. It describes the game's actual card-tie procedure, not a starting-player selection.
